items.summary: About the role The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company. About Arabian Private Holdings Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets. What you will do Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment. Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations. Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies. Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals. Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates. Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized. Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews. Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports. What we are looking for A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving. Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors. Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English. Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors. Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review. A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics. How we work We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients. What the role offers A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market. Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates. Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region. The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote. Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health. Please mention the word **TRIVIALLY** and tag RMjAuOTcuMTk2LjE2MQ== when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMjAuOTcuMTk2LjE2MQ==). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

items.description: NTT DATA is a team of more than 190,000 diverse professionals, operating in more than 50 countries throughout the world. The sectors where we have activities include: telecommunications, finance, industry, utilities, energy, public administration and health. Our mission? Offer technological solutions, business, strategy, development and maintenance of applications, while being a benchmark in consulting. All thanks to the collaboration between teams, the human quality of our people and the fact that we do not conform to what is established, we always seek innovation that brings us closer to the future. Our essence has led us to the forefront of technology, breaking paradigms and providing solutions that truly respond to the needs of each client. Our talent has led us to be one of the top 6 technology companies in the world. Because #Greattech, needs #GreatPeople, like you NTT DATA is looking for high-achieving team players that are quickly adaptable to new challenges and entrepreneurial ventures. We are looking for a Change Management Consultant to work remotely in LATAM with our global clients. Overview: We’re seeking a Change Management Consultant to support the successful delivery of digital transformation initiatives across SAP, Salesforce, data, and AI programs. This role works closely with client stakeholders and technical teams to drive adoption, manage change activities, and ensure business outcomes are realized. The position offers hands-on exposure to a dynamic, client-facing environment with opportunities to lead engagement strategies and deliver measurable impact across organizations. Responsibilities: Define end-to-end Change Management strategy and execution across technology programs. Conduct stakeholder identification, mapping, and engagement planning at all levels. Perform impact assessments across roles, processes, and systems. Define adoption KPIs and measurement frameworks to track success. Design and execute communication strategies and messaging plans. Develop and deliver training and enablement programs for end users. Facilitate workshops and sessions with leadership, teams, and employees. Create and manage change assets including communications, training materials, and plans. Drive adoption activities across discovery, design, testing, and deployment phases. Support UAT, pilot programs, and go-live readiness activities. Partner with technical teams to align change with delivery. Track, analyze, and report adoption metrics and outcomes. Act as a trusted advisor to clients to ensure successful transformation outcomes. Requirements: 3+ years of experience in Change Management within technology-driven transformations. Experience supporting enterprise implementations such as SAP, Salesforce, data, or AI initiatives. Proven ability to execute across the full change lifecycle from strategy to measurement. Strong knowledge of structured Change Management methodologies such as ADKAR. Strong client-facing consulting experience in dynamic environments. Ability to work autonomously and drive results independently. Experience managing stakeholders in large organizations. Excellent communication, facilitation, and storytelling abilities PROSCI ADKAR certification or equivalent Change Management certification preferred. Why NTT DATA? Empowerment and rewards are the cornerstone of our career development model. We are a young, fast-growing company, with a highly innovative and entrepreneurial spirit, because of this professional experience and growth will be unmatched. Our talent and positive attitude allows us to transform our goals into achievements, and projects into realities. NTT DATA is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action-Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class. NTT DATA is an Equal Opportunity Employer Male/Female/Disabled/Veteran and a VEVRAA Federal Contractor.

items.description: Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences. Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta. About the role: As a founding Strategic Sales Director for Iberia, you will own 8-12 of the largest strategic accounts across Spain and/or Portugal — IBEX35-caliber banking, telco, insurance, utilities, and travel enterprises. You'll run complex, multi-level sales cycles from 6 to 18 months, build both the business case and the technical win alongside your Solutions Consultant, and drive long-term land-and-expand strategy while continuing to bring in new logos. As part of the founding Iberia team, you'll work alongside a 10-person Madrid-based org (SDR, SC, and Customer Success) and help shape the region's go-to-market strategy from the ground up. Responsibilities: Manage a portfolio of 8-12 top strategic accounts in Spain and/or Portugal Generate your own pipeline — Cresta drives strong inbound, but Strategic AEs are expected to self-source roughly 50% of pipeline Orchestrate complex, multi-level sales cycles (6-18 months) across buying committees, procurement, legal, and security Build the business case and the technical win in partnership with your Solutions Consultant and extended team Drive land-and-expand strategy with a long-term vision for each account, while continuing to prioritize new-logo acquisition Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and Engineering to deliver an exceptional customer experience Qualifications We Value: 8+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, including at least 4 years as a quota-carrying individual contributor selling into large Spanish enterprises (IBEX35 or equivalent: banking, telco, insurance, utilities, travel) Verified track record closing deals of €500K+ ARR / €1M+ TCV, including at least one deal exceeding €1M TCV at an IBEX35-caliber account New-logo hunting as your primary motion — majority of attainment historically from net-new logos rather than installed-base expansion Experience navigating complex 6-18 month cycles, including RFPs, buying committees, and procurement/legal/security review in regulated industries Existing C-level/VP network within Spanish enterprise accounts Nice-to-Have: CX / contact center / conversational AI domain exposure (CCaaS, WEM, analytics, virtual agents) Experience opening a market or territory from zero for a hyper-growth vendor Experience co-selling with SIs and channel partners (e.g. Accenture, Telefónica Tech, Sabio-type ecosystem) Familiarity with Ley SAC and Spanish regulatory drivers in customer service MEDDPICC (or equivalent) formally trained Language & Travel: Native or negotiation-grade Spanish, fluent English; Portuguese is a strong plus Madrid-based, with travel across the Iberian Peninsula expected Perks & Benefits: We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced Compensation at Cresta Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table. The posted base salary range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family. This role is variable target compensation eligible. There is potential to exceed target earnings when goals are surpassed. OTE Range: TBD (comp benchmarking in progress) + Offers Equity We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Cresta employee, reach out to recruiting@cresta.ai

items.description: Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization .We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey. We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses. We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey. We're designing the future of autonomous marketing , taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do. And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi AI — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora. As a Strategic Account Executive at Bloomreach, you will lead new-business sales in multi-stakeholder environments and manage end-to-end, complex deal cycles. You’ll own the full sales cycle—from prospecting and qualification through pricing, negotiation, and close—delivering new revenue across the Spanish market. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with SDRs, Solutions Consultants, and key internal teams, as well as external partners, to open, advance, and win strategic opportunities. Your work will be pivotal in driving our growth in the region. Key Responsibilities: Develop and execute a targeted cross-regional sales strategy to penetrate key prospects (C-level), acquire new logos, and drive revenue growth Act as the CEO of your territory by assembling and leading a cross-functional virtual team to execute go-to-market strategies, including entering new markets or developing green markets when required. Hand over the deals to the Account Management to ensure a seamless customer experience Qualify leads early and effectively by identifying pain points and matching personas to Bloomreach’s Ideal Customer Profile (ICP). Demonstrate strong proficiency in sales methodologies such as Value-Based Selling, MEDDPICC, or Challenger Sales to navigate complex sales cycles and drive high-value deals. Ensure a robust sales pipeline by maintaining 3x the quarterly target through active prospecting and engaging effectively with C-level clients via various channels, including cold-calls, marketing lead follow-ups, RFPs, professional relationships, local marketing agency contacts, webinars, networking and face-to-face meetings. Collaborate closely with your CEA, channel partner, marketing, enablement, product and customer success teams, to revive old or stalled opportunities, qualify opportunities, and actively mature opportunities consistently Conduct thorough business needs analyses, prepare high-level client briefs, demos, and proposals presenting the unique value proposition of Bloomreach, and explain how it satisfies their needs. Clearly articulate how Bloomreach provides value over competitors and ensures shortlisting for purchasing decisions. Understand the Request for Proposal (RFP) process and influence it early on. Manage the CRM system to ensure accurate reporting and forecasting, maintaining high standards of data hygiene. Multithread to build and maintain solid long-term client relationships with key decision-makers and influencers, offering regular follow-ups and checking in on evolving needs. Provide insights on market trends, competitive landscape, and customer feedback to improve our product and sales effectiveness. Demonstrate initiative in your role to grow the business. Consistently achieve and exceed new business revenue targets. Act as a mentor or "buddy" for other regions, teams and junior team members. Follow instructions of the manager and complete additional duties as needed. What We’re Looking For: 5+ years years of quota-carrying experience (B2B sales) selling software or software-as-a-service (SaaS) Deep knowledge of MarTech technologies, CRM, Marketing Automation, CMS, Search and Merch or data capabilities A proven track record of meeting and exceeding revenue quota in a Sales Manager or equivalent role Well-established presence in the local markets with a relevant network The ability to successfully negotiate and close deals in a highly collaborative team environment Detail oriented, relationship-building skills, and a focus on a high level of customer service, having a passion for building rapport with clients and helping their businesses The ability to adapt to new environments and use your own initiative Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including high-calibre presentation skills Excellent time management skills, positive attitude and a “love of selling” The base salary range for this position is €62,000-€77,500. The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above. #LI-SF1 The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one. We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication. We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style. We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents. We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead. We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*. The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.4/5 rating. Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.* Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. items.description: Principal Data Standards Consultant ICON plc is a world-leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development Principal Data Standard Consultant UK As a Principal Clinical Data Standards Consultant at ICON Plc, you will: Provide expert-level functional knowledge in at least one standards domain, contributing to the development of standards content both internally and for sponsor-facing projects. Develop, implement, and maintain ICON standards libraries in compliance with CDISC, sponsor, and regulatory requirements. Act as a subject matter expert to guide standards implementation and ensure compliance across clinical data management activities. Apply deep understanding of business challenges to recommend and drive best practices , improving processes, products, and services to enhance competitive differentiation. Collaborate cross-functionally to define data collection strategies and standards for clinical trials. Participate in standards governance activities , influencing decision-making and providing expert input on complex topics. Lead or contribute to departmental initiatives , potentially acting as a project lead with responsibility for coordinating team members. Support the development of training materials and reference documentation across standards topics such as CDASH, SDTM, ADaM, Controlled Terminology, define-XML, and regulatory submissions. Stay up to date with industry trends, regulatory changes, and emerging standards , ensuring continuous improvement of ICON practices. Provide mentorship and guidance to more junior team members. Requirements: A Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., Life Sciences, Computer Science, or similar); advanced degrees are advantageous. Approximately 8+ years of experience in clinical data management, with significant expertise in data standards. Advanced proficiency in CDISC standards and strong knowledge of regulatory requirements (FDA, EMA, etc.). Proven experience with EDC build/design tools , such as Medidata Rave and/or Veeva Vault CDMS. Demonstrated ability to solve complex problems , using advanced analytical thinking and sound judgment to develop innovative solutions. Strong leadership capabilities, including experience leading initiatives or mentoring team members . Excellent interpersonal, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to present, defend analyses, and secure stakeholder alignment on complex topics . Ability to significantly impact operational, project, or departmental objectives , ensuring delivery of high-quality outcomes aligned with business strategy. If you are ready to make a meaningful impact in the field of clinical data standards and contribute to innovative, high-impact clinical projects, we encourage you to apply and join ICON’s growing team. #LI-JC3 #LI-Remote What ICON can offer you: Our success depends on the quality of our people. Our benefits examples include: Various annual leave entitlements A range of health insurance offerings to suit you and your family’s needs. Competitive retirement planning offerings to maximize savings and plan with confidence for the years ahead. Global Employee Assistance Programme, TELUS Health, offering 24-hour access to a global network of over 80,000 independent specialised professionals who are there to support you and your family’s well-being. Life assurance Flexible country-specific optional benefits, including childcare vouchers, bike purchase schemes, discounted gym memberships, subsidised travel passes, health assessments, among others. items.description: Requisition #: 18836 Functional Area: Consulting; Workplace Safety Employment Type: Independent Contractor Work Options: Independent Contractor - varies based on Scope of Work #LI-Remote Work Hours: As needed to fulfill contract requirements Posting J. J. Keller & Associates, Inc. is a North American organization providing innovative safety and regulatory compliance guidance and solutions to organizations across the U. S. and Canada. For over 70 years, organizations of all sizes have relied on J. J. Keller to help them create safe work environments for their employees and comply with ever-changing regulations. As we look to expand our service offerings, we are seeking to add an Independent Contractor to our Workplace Safety Consulting practice who has subject matter expertise related to OSHA General Industry . This opportunity is for an Independent Contractor only and does not constitute an employment relationship. Independent Contractors must reside in the U. S. and be legally authorized to perform services within the United States. To be considered as an Independent Contractor, individuals must: Operate as an independent safety consulting business (e.g., sole proprietor, incorporated entity, or equivalent) Provide services to multiple clients and maintain a non-exclusive consulting practice Supply their own tools, methodologies, instructional materials, and business processes necessary to deliver services Be responsible for all taxes, insurance, and business-related expenses Provide their own computer, equipment, and tools necessary to perform services Maintain appropriate professional liability coverage, as required under the contractual agreement Travel requirements vary based on client engagements, audit needs, and training delivery, and are defined by project or statement of work. Types of Services Requested Provides expert advice, safety consulting and educational services to J. J. Keller clients on construction safety and health matters through onsite engagements, off-site locations, and/or internet-based delivery methods in accordance with defined project scope. Designs, develops, documents, and maintains training curriculum and instructional materials for general and client-specific applications. Conducts safety audits, inspections, and risk assessments, based on applicable regulatory standards and client requirements related to excavation, fall protection, scaffolding, trenching, heavy equipment, electrical safety, and roadway work zones. Monitors relevant regulatory and compliance applicable to the scope of service and incorporate changes into deliverables and training content as appropriate. Communicates regulatory updates, recommendations, and findings to designated client contacts through reports, briefings, or presentations. Provides advisory support to interpret regulatory requirements and practical application, without assuming responsibility for client compliance enforcement or ongoing operational oversight. Qualifications Experience: Extensive experience in construction safety and health, with a strong focus on OSHA General Industry. Demonstrated expertise providing safety consulting, regulatory advisory, auditing, and training services to commercial or industrial clients. Other Skills/Qualifications : Strong understanding of federal, state, and local safety regulations. Proven history of providing independent safety consulting services within consulting and/or complex corporate environments. Proficiency using business productivity tools (MS Office suite) necessary to deliver reports, presentations, and training materials. Excellent communication skills – verbal, written and presentation Demonstrated ability to work effectively with client representatives at all levels. Maintains a high level of regulatory expertise. Strong working knowledge of sales, marketing, and finance concepts related to operating an independent consulting practice. Ability to legally operate a motor vehicle to perform required services. Physical Requirements Work is performed primarily in a standard office environment. Work involves operation of personal computer equipment for extended periods of time. Frequent travel to offsite offices, customer sites and/or industry and training events is required. Travel Requirements: 80% We Protect People & The Businesses They Run™ J. J. Keller History: November 1, 2023, marked 70 years of business for J. J. Keller & Associates, Inc. Click HERE to take a tour through three generations of this family-owned business – from our founding as a one-man consulting firm through decades of delivering on our purpose of protecting people and the businesses they run. If you experience system-related issues or need assistance with the online application, please call (920) 720-7700. Professional Referral Program: Not the right role for you, but know someone who could be a great fit? Click HERE to refer them to us through our Professional Referral Program and you will earn a cash payment if your referral is hired. J. J. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: London, England URL: https://www.mobiloud.com Work location: Remote, anywhere outside the United States Sales territory: North America, UK, and EU Contract type: Full-time contractor Compensation: Competitive base plus commissions tied to closed revenue About MobiLoud MobiLoud helps established ecommerce brands turn their existing websites into iOS and Android apps, without rebuilding their product or running a second system. Our customers use MobiLoud to drive repeat purchases, recover abandoned carts through push notifications, and reduce their dependence on paid acquisition. We're a bootstrapped, profitable, remote-first SaaS company founded in 2013. We've published 2,000+ apps and have hundreds of active customers today, including Estee Lauder, John Varvatos, Jack & Jones, and Tadashi Shoji. Our team is 16 people, all remote and hands-on. The Role Email and SMS still drive revenue for ecommerce brands, but deliverability, SMS compliance, and acquisition costs keep making retention harder. A mobile app gives their best customers another direct channel through push notifications, tied to the website they already operate. That is the sale. You own the close for ecommerce brands across North America, the UK, and Europe. Discovery, demo, proposal, pricing conversations, contracting, and getting the signature on the order form are all part of the job. Most buyers are founders, ecommerce leads, digital directors, and marketing leaders. This is an inbound-led closing role: meetings come mainly from inbound demand, SDR-sourced pipeline, older opportunities, and referrals. You turn the right opportunities into signed customers. This posting is for candidates based outside the United States. You can be anywhere if you can work with UK/EU hours and have regular overlap with US East Coast business hours for demos and buyer conversations. You need to sound natural with North American and European buyers, understand how DTC ecommerce brands think, and learn the mobile app revenue case quickly. What You'll Do • Run discovery with inbound and SDR-sourced prospects • Lead demos tied to the prospect's site, traffic, retention stack, and commercial goals • Build the proposal, pricing case, and ROI narrative • Run pricing and commercial conversations • Manage the contracting process through signature and handoff • Follow up on stalled deals and re-engage older good-fit opportunities • Keep the CRM current, with clear next steps, close dates, and deal notes Who You Are • You have closed B2B deals before and can talk clearly about deal size, sales cycle, buyer type, win rate, objections, and what you personally owned • You have SaaS or software sales experience, ideally with products that require some technical understanding: websites, integrations, ecommerce platforms, apps, implementation, or developer-adjacent work • You have native or near-native English. Written and spoken English both need to feel natural to US, Canadian, UK, and EU buyers • You understand North American business culture, buying expectations, consumer brands, ecommerce, DTC, and how senior buyers like to communicate • You can sell to founders, heads of digital, ecommerce leads, and marketing leaders without sounding scripted • You are comfortable learning both the commercial and technical side of ecommerce: retention, repeat purchase, owned channels, paid acquisition pressure, websites, mobile apps, integrations, and why brands invest in apps • You can work with UK/EU hours and have regular overlap with US East Coast business hours for demos and buyer conversations Compensation • Competitive base plus commissions tied to closed revenue • Full-time independent contractor basis. You invoice monthly and handle your own tax obligations • You may be based anywhere outside the United States. MobiLoud pays in USD Why This Role • You sell to established ecommerce brands with real revenue and clear commercial problems • Direct line to the founder. Deal review, pricing decisions, and feedback happen quickly • You work on apps for brands like Estee Lauder, John Varvatos, Jack & Jones, and Tadashi Shoji • Remote contractor role with competitive USD compensation, commission upside, and no office requirement • Set your own hours and take unlimited time off. Give notice when you're out, that's the only rule Not a Fit If • You are based in the United States • You have not closed B2B deals before • You have not personally sold software or SaaS before • Your English is good but still too formal, scripted, or unnatural for North American buyers • You do not follow ecommerce, DTC brands, North American consumer culture, or how online brands grow • You need close daily management to stay focused How to Apply Email jobs@mobiloud.com with the subject line Account Executive - MobiLoud. Include: • Where you are based, and how your working day overlaps with UK/EU and US East Coast business hours • A recent B2B software or SaaS deal you personally closed: what you sold, who the buyer was, deal size, sales cycle, and what you owned from discovery through signature • How many new-logo B2B deals you personally closed in the last 12 months • One ecommerce or DTC brand you think could sell well through a mobile app, and why • Your CV and LinkedIn profile To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/mobiloud-account-executive

items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote URL: http://gowalter.co Description About Simetrik Created in 2019, Simetrik is a robust B2B platform powered by no code and generative AI. It empowers financial and operational teams by allowing them to automate all reconciliations from start to finish, and anticipate and manage risks all on a single, intuitive, and robust interface inspired by spreadsheets. The company's global footprint spans over 35 countries, monitoring over 200 million records daily. About the role As BDR, you will be responsible to make the first contact of prospects via outbound and inbound and generate quality opportunities for the sales force. You will have the chance to focus your attention and efforts on customer acquisition, lead generation, and prospect management, as this role will gather and meet with potential clients. The business development representative will also be responsible to research client business referrals, network, and web leads; provide prospective customers/clients with all services offered and additional presentations as needed, and work with clients to create solutions for their needs and consult throughout the sales process. What you’ll achieve: ● Generate pipeline for enterprise account executives through persistent, high-volume outreach and create customized messaging to drive qualified opportunities and account expansion. ● Leverage a multi-channel outbound prospecting approach (outbound calling, email, LinkedIn Outreach etc.), developing and refining team sequences, templates, and messaging to build a repeatable, scalable process. ● Cultivate value-driven conversations with Director and VP-level personas across complex cross-functional teams and consistently create compelling messaging and events to achieve meeting goals. ● Develop a territory plan with AE and CSM based on account tier scoring to drive the highest ARR. ● Proactively update activity metrics, meetings, SQO, and pipeline on a weekly basis. Identify gaps between prospecting inputs and outputs. ● Effectively execute high-impact trials, meet SLA requirements, and leverage territory heat maps and buyer’s journey to triage target accounts with ABM strategy. ● Understand Simetrik use-cases, relevant workflows/processes, and ways that Simetrik can deliver value. Requirements About you: ● At least 3-4 years of Sales or Sales Development experience. ● Familiarity with sales tools such as Salesforce, Outreach, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn Navigator to network with potential customers and manage your book of business. ● Demonstrated success in driving outbound prospecting strategy and process to high-level personas and decision-makers to achieve pipeline goals. ● Passion for a career in technology and an ability to speak knowledgeably about the industry. ● Excellent writing and verbal communication skills, with a focus on persuasive messaging and the ability to tailor your communication style to different audiences. ● Strong collaboration skills, particularly in working with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to drive business outcomes. ● Clear communication, a deep sense of empathy, and a commitment to integrity. ● Demonstrated curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making Benefits Benefits ● Competitive compensation packages ● Ample career growth opportunities as we continue rapidly grow ● Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits, creating and collaborating is everyday business. ● Open communication with management and company leadership. ● Small, dynamic teams = massive impact. ● $500 a year for you to invest in learning. ● Unlimited PTO ● 12 holidays Simetrik considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, gender, age, color, religion, national origin, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, protected military/veteran status, or any other legally protected factor. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: US - California - Thousand Oaks URL: http://amgen.com Career Category Marketing Job Description What you will do Let's do this. Let's change the world. At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives everything we do. Within the US Bone Health Business Unit, we have set a bold ambition to help prevent 3 million osteoporotic fractures by 2033 by transforming how osteoporosis is recognized, diagnosed, treated, and prioritized across the healthcare ecosystem. Achieving this ambition requires more than innovative medicines—it requires transforming the osteoporosis ecosystem through stakeholder alignment, disease awareness, innovation, and coordinated action. Bone IMPACT (Igniting Momentum through Policy, Alliances, Communications, and Technology) is Amgen's enterprise above-brand strategy to advance this ambition by mobilizing partners across the healthcare ecosystem and creating the conditions that improve disease awareness, diagnosis, treatment, and fracture prevention. The Marketing Director, Bone IMPACT will lead the evolution of Amgen's enterprise market-shaping strategy for osteoporosis by identifying, prioritizing, and advancing initiatives that transform the future osteoporosis landscape. Working across Marketing, Medical, Health Systems, Government Affairs, Corporate Communications, Advocacy, Value & Access, HEOR, Legal, Regulatory, Compliance, and external stakeholders, this leader will shape strategy, build strategic partnerships, identify emerging opportunities, and align organizational capabilities to accelerate meaningful improvements in osteoporosis care, with the opportunity to build a team and develop talent as the capability expands. This is a unique opportunity to help build one of Amgen's most strategic enterprise capabilities while shaping the future of osteoporosis care for one of the largest and most underserved patient populations in healthcare. Success in this highly visible leadership role requires strategic thinking, influence without authority, external partnership leadership, and the ability to translate bold ideas into executable strategies within a complex, highly regulated environment. Key Responsibilities Lead Enterprise Strategy & Cross-Functional Leadership Develop the long-term Bone IMPACT vision and enterprise strategy aligned with Bone Health business priorities. Identify emerging opportunities that strengthen the osteoporosis ecosystem and accelerate disease awareness, diagnosis, treatment, and fracture prevention. Lead above-brand market-shaping initiatives by aligning priorities across Marketing, Medical, Health Systems, Government Affairs, Corporate Communications, Advocacy, Value & Access, HEOR, and other key functions. Establish governance and integrated planning to align initiatives, partnerships, sponsorships, and investments around shared strategic priorities. Incubate innovative capabilities, evaluate impact, and transition mature initiatives to long-term business owners while identifying new opportunities for growth. Lead National Partnerships & Ecosystem Leadership Build trusted relationships with national medical societies, advocacy organizations, professional associations, health systems, technology companies, policy organizations, and other influential stakeholders. Convene strategic coalitions and partnerships that advance shared priorities through education, advocacy, innovation, and implementation initiatives. Represent Amgen as a trusted enterprise partner committed to advancing the osteoporosis ecosystem. Monitor the external environment to identify new partnerships, collaborations, and market-shaping opportunities. Lead Above-Brand Strategic Communications & Market Activation Develop enterprise above-brand communication and market activation strategies that elevate osteoporosis as a national healthcare priority. Shape evidence-based disease narratives that connect osteoporosis to broader conversations around women's health, menopause, healthy aging, longevity, and fracture prevention. Identify opportunities to leverage strategic communications, public awareness, partnerships, thought leadership, and emerging media to accelerate stakeholder engagement and market transformation. Partner across Brand Marketing, Corporate Communications, Medical, Advocacy, Government Affairs, Health Systems, Value & Access, and external agencies to ensure above-brand engagement strategies complement branded marketing while advancing enterprise priorities. Lead the strategy—and, as appropriate, the development and execution—of enterprise above-brand awareness and market activation initiatives. Lead Innovation & Future Market Development With cross-functional partners, evaluate emerging trends, AI-enabled capabilities, technologies, and strategic partnerships to identify new opportunities that transform osteoporosis awareness, patient engagement, and care delivery. Translate external insights into business cases, pilot initiatives, and scalable enterprise strategies. Foster a culture of innovation by identifying opportunities that position Bone IMPACT to address future market needs. Measure Impact & Optimize Strategy Define success measures that evaluate ecosystem impact, stakeholder engagement, partnership effectiveness, market activation, and strategic progress. Monitor performance and refine enterprise priorities based on market insights and measurable outcomes. Manage agency partners, external vendors, and program budgets to maximize impact and return on investment. items.description: Design Headquarters: Dire Dawa, Ethiopia URL: http://iisd.org Background The Scaling Urban Nature-based Solutions (NbS) for Climate Adaptation in Sub-Saharan Africa (SUNCASA) is a 3-year project aiming at enhancing climate resilience and promoting gender equality, social inclusion, and biodiversity protection across three cities: Dire Dawa (Ethiopia), Kigali (Rwanda) and Johannesburg (South Africa). Led by the International Institute for Sustainable Development and the World Resources Institute, and implemented in partnership with local organizations and communities, SUNCASA seeks to address climate change impacts—such as floods, landslides, and soil erosion—through gender-responsive and socially inclusive NbS. These include afforestation, reforestation, agroforestry, urban greening, the removal of invasive alien species, and the creation of vegetated buffer zones in flood-prone areas. Entering its third and final year of the current implementation phase, SUNCASA is already achieving significant results, generating measurable adaptation outcomes and strengthening the resilience of communities and landscapes across its project sites. To sustain these achievements beyond the project time frame, SUNCASA is investing in building local ownership and stewardship, with a particular emphasis on engaging children and youth as future custodians of their environments. For more information, visit www.suncasa.org . As part of this effort, SUNCASA is developing a series of four animated videos, with stories and scripts co-created alongside local partners to ensure they reflect community realities, priorities, and cultural contexts. Through engaging storytelling and accessible messages, the animations will encourage young audiences to understand the importance of protecting local ecosystems and livelihoods, recognize their role in sustaining climate adaptation efforts, and contribute to building more resilient and sustainable communities. Purpose of the Consultancy Within the framework of SUNCASA’s Communications Strategy, IISD is seeking an experienced animator or animation studio to conceptualize, design, and produce a series of three animated videos showcasing the project's NbS impacts and highlighting the role of local youth in sustaining these achievements across SUNCASA's three project cities. A fourth animation will focus on promoting the project's gender equality and social inclusion (GESI) approach. Working closely with SUNCASA's Communications team and representatives from the project's local partners, the consultant will be responsible for translating existing scripts into engaging visual narratives through the development of high-quality animations of approximately 2–2.5 minutes each. The videos should communicate the project's approach, results, and impact in a way that is compelling, accessible, and suitable for diverse audiences, with a particular focus on young people. Animations and supporting illustrations must be designed on Adobe Creative Cloud software—After Effects, Illustrator, and InDesign. SUNCASA will provide relevant reference materials—including photographs, videos, project documentation, and brand assets—to inform the visual concept, character design, and storytelling. The animations will be based on scripts co-created with local partners to ensure they authentically reflect the social, cultural, and environmental contexts of each project location. The consultant will be expected to develop a distinctive visual style that resonates with local audiences while maintaining consistency across the animation series. The animations are expected to be developed primarily in English. The SUNCASA Communications team will provide all voiceover and dialogue recordings, including versions in local languages such as Amharic, Afaan Oromo, and Kinyarwanda, which the consultant will integrate into the final productions. The assignment covers the full animation production process, including visual concept development, character and environment design, storyboarding, illustration, animation, editing, and post-production. Final deliverables will include landscape and portrait versions of each animation, optimized for web, social media, and mobile platforms. The consultant will also provide all editable source files—including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files—to allow future adaptation and reuse by the SUNCASA Communications team. The completed animations will support educational and awareness-raising activities led by SUNCASA’s local partners, particularly among children and youth. They will also be disseminated through community WhatsApp and Telegram groups and promoted through SUNCASA’s and partners’ websites and social media channels, helping to expand outreach, strengthen engagement, and reinforce the long-term sustainability of project outcomes. Objectives of the Consultancy General Objective The overall objective of this consultancy is to design and produce a series of four short, animated videos that communicate the achievements and impacts of the SUNCASA project in an engaging and accessible way. This includes three animations highlighting the project’s NbS interventions and their contribution to community and ecosystem resilience across three cities, while one will focus on SUNCASA’s GESI approach. The animations aim to strengthen local ownership and long-term sustainability of project results by engaging children and youth as key audiences. Through culturally relevant storytelling co-developed with local partners, the animations should inspire behavioural change and reinforce the role of youth as key agents of resilience and environmental stewardship. The final products will serve as adaptable communication tools for community outreach, education, and broader dissemination through digital platforms and partner networks. Specific Objectives To design and produce four high-quality animated videos (approximately 2–2.5 minutes each) that communicate SUNCASA’s results, impacts, and approaches in an engaging, accessible, and visually compelling format, particularly to younger audiences. To develop three animations showcasing SUNCASA’s NbS interventions and their contribution to strengthening the resilience of communities and ecosystems across the project’s three cities. To produce one animation highlighting SUNCASA’s GESI approach and its role in promoting inclusive and equitable climate adaptation outcomes. To lead the full animation production process, including visual concept development, character and environment design, storyboarding, illustration, animation, editing, and post-production, in close collaboration with SUNCASA’s Communications team and local partners. To deliver final outputs in both landscape and portrait formats, as well as short versions of each video optimized for social media, along with all editable source files (including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files) to enable future adaptation and reuse by the SUNCASA Communications team. Tasks and Deliverables The consultant will be responsible for leading the full animation production process as outlined below: Activity 1: Inception and Creative Development Review all aesthetics and visual reference materials provided by SUNCASA. Participate in a kickoff meeting with the SUNCASA Communications teams and representatives of the local partner organizations. Develop a creative concept and visual approach aligned with SUNCASA branding and the visual references provided. Prepare a detailed production plan and timeline, including at least three rounds of feedback and the platform on which concepts and drafts will be shared for review. Deliverable 1 : Detailed work plan, including time frame; Creative concept with animation style and visual approach. Activity 2: Storyboards - Based on the co-created scripts provided by the SUNCASA Communications team and informed by the approved creative concept, the consultant will design individual storyboards for each animation. Deliverable 2 : Individual storyboards for each video, with a detailed description of each sequence and scene. Activity 3 : Initial Video Drafts - Following the scripts provided by the SUNCASA Comms team and the approved storyboard, the consultant will develop initial versions of all four animations with no audio and submit them for review. Based on feedback, the updated versions will be created and submitted for approval. - Drafts should include motion graphics, character animations, as well as maps and geographic visualization where applicable. Deliverable 3 : The initial and updated cut of each video animation draft with no audio, including the feedback provided by the team. Activity 4: Final versions of all four animated videos in English and integration of voiceover, dialogues in local languages, as well as soundtrack; create cut-down social media cuts - The consultant will use the approved versions to integrate the voiceover, dialogues, and soundtrack into each animation. - In addition to English, one animation will have a version in Kinyarwanda; and one will have versions in Amharic and Afaan Oromo—translations to be provided by the SUNCASA Communications team. - An additional round of feedback will be required at this stage before approval of the final versions. - In addition to the full animations, the consultant will deliver a cut-down version (30 to 45 seconds) of each video, optimized for social media. Deliverable 4 : A final version of each animation in English with voiceover, dialogues, and soundtrack in local languages, as applicable. A cut-down version of each animation for social media. Activity 5: Submit all editable source files (including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files) - Organize, name, and share all working files, including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files. Deliverable 5 : A folder with all required assets to be shared with the SUNCASA Communications team. Read the full Terms of Reference here for Reporting, Evaluation and Selection Criteria. Consultancy for the Design and Production of Four Animated Videos Showcasing SUNCASA’s Achievements and Inspiring Youth Engagement in Sustaining Project Results Application deadline: August 3, 2026 Application Process All applications must be submitted in English. To apply for this consultancy, please send: Cover Letter outlining relevant professional experience of proposed consultant(s). Please include the name and contact details of the primary contact person. Detailed resume of proposed consultant(s) highlighting relevant experience in all stages of animation production, from creative concept to post-production. Technical Proposal outlining understanding of the assignment and how the consultant(s) plan to undertake the project, including a proposed work plan and timeline. The proposed work plan must align with the deliverables and timeline set out in Sections 4 and 5. Portfolio with at least three examples of relevant animation videos. Please indicate the links to the videos in the technical proposal. Financial Proposal that includes the consultant’s daily rate and any additional costs associated with this assignment, with all costs clearly broken down and aligned to each deliverable and key activities outlined in the Scope of Work. Financial proposals must be aligned with the scope described in Section 5 of this RFP. At least two (2) references from previous related projects. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/iisd-consultancy-for-the-design-and-production-of-four-animated-videos-showcasing-suncasa-s-achievements-and

items.description: Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance. Business Consultant, Dedicated Success at Realtor.com ® Are you an expert relationship builder? Are you experienced at developing deep executive-level relationships with premier strategic accounts?If you want to pursue your professional goals as you help grow an innovative real estate tech company, this work is for you. Join us as our newest Business Consultant, Dedicated Success andhelp change the world of real estate, one home at a time. The Business Consultant, Dedicated Success is responsible for leading, growing, and retaining Realtor.com’s most strategic and highest-value customer relationships. In this senior role, you’ll manage a portfolio of approximately 25 premier strategic accounts, developing deep executive-level relationships that cement Realtor.com as an indispensable business partner. You will provide a personalized, high-touch luxury experience, overseeing the entire post-sale lifecycle—from strategic implementation and custom training to high-stakes escalations and enterprise-wide renewals. As a strategic leader, you will build sophisticated partnerships based on trust, data-driven insights, and a deep understanding of your customers’ long-term business goals. Top Reasons to Apply: Deliver a High-Touch, Luxury Experience: Manage an elite portfolio of just ~40 premier, highest-value strategic accounts, allowing you the bandwidth to build deep, personalized, executive-level relationships and celebrate key milestones. Provide True Bespoke Consultation: Act as an indispensable business partner by diving deep into your clients’ unique operations and utilizing data-driven insights to deliver custom strategies, implementation plans, and best practices. Own the Enterprise Lifecycle: Take full ownership of the post-sale journey - from strategic implementation to high-stakes renewals - while traveling (~10%) to engage clients face-to-face and driving long-term revenue retention for Realtor.com’s top footprint. What You’ll Do : Build strong relationships with a small book of customers (~40 accounts), establishing Rea] as a friendly, trusted business partner. Provide a personalized experience for your customers, learning their business operations and systems in order to provide them with custom consultation, data, and best practices for their [Realtor.com|http://Realtor.com] products and services. Engage with customers on a personal level, celebrating not only their business milestones, but also their personal ones (e.g. birthdays, holidays). Retain and grow revenue with your customers by managing their post-sale experience. This includes product implementation, training, ongoing support, escalations, retention, and renewals. Travel for conferences, events, and customer engagement (~10% of your time). Execute effectively towards company initiatives set by leadership and corporate OKRs. Develop a thorough understanding of all key [Realtor.com|http://Realtor.com] business processes and products, recommending and implementing enhancements that will drive revenue with and improve the experience of high-value customers. Communicate effectively with individuals across all levels of the company, including Sales, Product, Marketing, Technology, Operations, and Finance. Have comprehensive business knowledge and technical skill on Salesforce, Focus Fire, and other enterprise systems. What You’ll Bring : To be successful in this role, the Business Consultant, Dedicated Success must be a people person who feels comfortable not only building a relationship with customers, but also building a personal connection. You are a self-starter who excels at managing your own schedules and priorities. You will own the success of your book of business, focusing on revenue retention and growth. What We Like To See / Measures of Success: Bachelor’s degree. 8 years of account management experience –key/major accounts. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work with PCs, Internet and Microsoft applications (Word, Excel, and Outlook). Salesforce experience. Knowledge of the real estate industry. Experience with technical customer support. How We Work : We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work three or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together. This is a U.S. based, remote role with ~10% required travel. At Realtor, we recognize that attracting the best talent is key to our strategy and success as a company. As a result, we aim for flexibility in structuring competitive compensation offers to ensure we are able to attract the best candidates. The quoted salary range represents our good faith estimate as to what our ideal candidates are likely to expect in the listed location. We tailor our offers based on the selected candidate’s experience, industry knowledge, technical and communication skills, location and other factors that may prove relevant during the interview process. All ranges are location based, ranges for positions in other locations may vary based on the local market. The annual OTE for this position is $112,000 - $135,000 USD. How We Reward You : Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to: Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage Family forming benefits 13 Paid Holidays Flexible Time Off 8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3.5% company match Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non-degreed programs 1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program Free snacks and refreshments in each office location Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com® Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you’ll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you’ll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. In return, we’ll provide you with a warm, welcoming, and inclusive culture; intellectual challenges; and the development opportunities you need to grow. Diversity is important to us, therefore, Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, status as a disabled veteran and/or veteran of the Vietnam Era or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Realtor.com® will provide reasonable accommodations for otherwise qualified disabled individuals.

items.description: Company MedHQ, LLC, is a fast growing, leading provider of consulting and technology enabled expert services for outpatient healthcare. With a 97% long-term, client retention rate spanning over 20 years, MedHQ serves Ambulatory Surgery Centers (ASCs), Surgical Hospitals, Physician Practices, and Hospital and Healthcare Outpatient Facilities nationwide. The MedHQ RITE Values: Respect, Innovation, Trust, and Energy, permeate all service line offerings with a unique personalized approach balancing exceptional transactional and emotional intelligence, and above all excellent customer service. MedHQ, LLC, is a 2022 Becker’s Top 150 Places to Work in Healthcare company. The MedHQ LLC service line offerings have grown organically over the years, beginning by providing high quality traditional human resource, accounting, and staff credentialing as a Professional Employer Organization, (PEO.) In 2022, MedHQ formed a relationship with 424 Capital, and quickly expanded into a well-rounded, menu services driven financial management company. This robust infusion of expert service line offerings has resulted in MedHQ and MedHQ clients’ efficiencies and growth. The MedHQ, LLC, menu of client services include Advisory, Client Human Resources, Client Accounting, Staff Credentialling, Clinical Staffing, and Revenue Cycle Services. For additional detailed information please review www.medhq.com and www.trajectoryrcs.com Job Summary: As a Patient Financial Services Representative at MedHQ, you will play a vital role in providing exceptional customer service to patients while effectively managing their medical billing inquiries and payment processing. In this role, you will handle inbound calls, assist patients with their financial concerns, and ensure a seamless revenue cycle management process. Fluency in both English and Spanish is required to serve our diverse patient base. Key Responsibilities: Patient Interaction: Professionally handle inbound calls from patients regarding their medical bills and financial matters. Engage with patients in a compassionate and empathetic manner, addressing their concerns and inquiries with utmost care. Billing and Payment Processing: Collect payments over the phone, ensuring accurate recording and documentation. Assist patients in setting up payment plans, as needed. Explanation of Benefits (EOB) Interpretation: Interpret and explain Explanation of Benefits (EOB) statements to patients, helping them understand insurance coverage and billed charges. Provide clarification on any discrepancies or questions related to EOBs. Claims Research and Resolution: Investigate and research claims that require further attention, such as denied claims or billing disputes. Collaborate with insurance companies and healthcare providers to resolve billing issues efficiently. Bilingual Communication: Communicate fluently in both English and Spanish to serve our diverse patient population effectively. Documentation and Reporting: Maintain detailed and accurate records of all patient interactions, payments, and resolutions. Generate reports as required to track and analyze billing and collection trends. Compliance and Regulations: Stay up-to-date with healthcare billing regulations and compliance standards. Ensure all interactions and processes adhere to HIPAA guidelines. Customer Service Excellence: Strive for first-call resolution and maintain high levels of patient satisfaction. Demonstrate patience, active listening, and problem-solving skills in addressing patient concerns. Qualifications: High school diploma or equivalent; some college coursework in a related field is a plus. Previous experience in a healthcare billing, revenue cycle management, or customer service role is required, minimum of 1 year. Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish is preferred. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Detail-oriented with excellent organizational abilities. Proficiency in using computer applications and billing software. Ability to handle confidential information with discretion. Understanding of healthcare billing codes, insurance terminology, and medical terminology is a plus. Benefits: Employer sponsored Major Medical Employer sponsored Dental Employer sponsored Vision Accidental Death and Disability insurance Short term disability 4.5% 401K matching Flexible spending account Generous paid time off True opportunity for advancement If you are a dedicated and compassionate individual who is fluent in both English and Spanish, with a passion for helping patients navigate their medical billing challenges, we encourage you to apply for the Patient Financial Services Representative position at Med HQ. Join us in making a difference in patients’ lives by ensuring their financial healthcare journey is as smooth as possible. This job is remote. **Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over spnsorship of an employment visa at this time.

items.description: Data and Analytics SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars. DATA ENGINEER (STARLINK NETWORK ANALYTICS, WIFI) At SpaceX, we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe. As a Data Engineer, you will be responsible for developing the strategy, key metrics, tools, software services, and processes for assessing how well key aspects of Starlink are scaling and how effective the Starlink Network is itself, in serving millions of users around the globe. You will work with operators, subsystem responsible engineers, software engineers, and network engineers inside the Starlink organization as well as key contacts with various major external partners to help ensure the growth of this program. RESPONSIBILITIES: Build and maintain mission-critical infrastructure, tools, processes, and custom software to objectively assess growth areas for the Starlink program Automate the aggregation of metrics and detection of widespread application issues across Starlink network, including WiFi Lead technical investigations about chronic application-level issues Build ground-based software systems that ingest, transform, and store data Apply data analytics, models, and techniques to data products created by space vehicles Fuse data from multiple sources to create usable information BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, physics, mathematics, or a STEM discipline 1+ years of data/software engineering experience (internship experience is applicable) Development experience in an object-oriented programming language (i.e. C, C++, Python) PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: Experience in networking technologies and WiFi protocols (TCP/UDP, 802.11, etc) Experience building predictive models and machine learning pipelines on real world data (clustering analysis, prediction, anomaly detection) Experience in custom ETL design, implementation, and maintenance Experience handling large (TB+) datasets Experience with developing and deploying tools used for data analysis Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment that includes working with changing needs and requirements Ability to take on projects that require taking initiative and developing new expertise ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: Pay Range: Level 1: $125,000 - $150,000 Level 2: $145,000 - $175,000 Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday. ITAR REQUIREMENTS: To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here . SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status. Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com .
